title: The brain does not produce or cause consciousness

statements.text: The brain does not produce consciousness as the liver produces bile, and physiological processes do not turn into experiences through some metaphysical transformation. Asking how the body produces the mind is like asking how lightning causes thunder. Casting the relation in causal terms makes the hard problem harder than it needs to be.

sources.quote: the brain does not "produce" or "cause" consciousness
Asking how my body produces my mental experience is like asking how lightning causes thunder.
